requirement.requirement_text: The system runs daily on a schedule. Input: a Google Sheet configuration listing monitoring targets of two types — topic keywords (search terms) and competitor subreddits. For each target, the system shall: (1) route the task into one of two paths (Competitor vs. Keyword) based on the input type; (2) use a cloud browser automation service to navigate to the target Reddit pages and extract the latest posts without getting blocked; (3) clean the scraped data and combine the top 3 posts for the target; (4) use an AI agent to analyze the data and generate an executive summary for each topic, summarizing the top 3 trending posts into a single concise daily report and filtering out noise; (5) automatically clean, format, and archive the intelligence with source links into Google Sheets, appending the final reports to the Report sheet. Visible outcome: a daily intelligence digest, archived in the Report Google Sheet with columns Date, Competitor/Keyword, Summary, and Link. Failure handling: not specified in the public description.
